title: IVE premieres new album Lux Can Kill at Spotify DIVE Academy in Seoul - CHOSUNBIZ
text:
IVE premieres new album Lux Can Kill at Spotify DIVE Academy in Seoul - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 20일(화) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment IVE premieres new album Lux Can Kill at Spotify DIVE Academy in Seoul 
 입력 2026.10.20. 16:21 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 The group IVE (IVE: Ahn Yujin, Ga-eul, Ray, Jang Wonyoung, Liz, Leeseo) made a dazzling return as they successfully completed the Spotify DIVE Academy.
 On the 19th, IVE held "Spotify DIVE ACADEMY" with Spotify at Seoul ARC Gangnam and revealed the new song performance for the first time.
 IVE premiered the performance that day and shared behind-the-scenes of the mini album "Lux Can Kill," scheduled for release on the 26th, creating special memories with DIVE (the official fandom name).
 Starting with the bewitching "BANG BANG," which unleashed a powerful momentum and drew thunderous cheers from the start, IVE introduced each member's hero character featured in the new release — Captain Purple (Ahn Yujin), Wonder Green (Ga-eul), Jin Yellow (Ray), Bat Pink (Jang Wonyoung), Super Blue (Liz), Spider Red (Leeseo) — heightening immersion in the world view.
 IVE described "Lux Can Kill" as an album "that started from the concept of heroes who can deliver a critical hit just by existing," and increased anticipation for the new release by delivering spoilers with witty moves and expressions. They also showcased a different charm by using the hero concept to introduce the abilities that DIVE picked for IVE.
 IVE performed the title track "Lux Can Kill" and the album track "Girls Girls Girls" for the first time. Through "Lux Can Kill," they emitted a confident aura while showcasing synchronized group choreography with excellent tempo control and a point move in which they form a gun shape with their hands to mimic shooting, producing strong addictiveness. Through "Girls Girls Girls," they unleashed their characteristic vitality and proved IVE's limitless charm.
 IVE, which announced a glamorous return with the release of "Lux Can Kill." The music video for "Lux Can Kill" ranked No. 1 on YouTube music video trending worldwide immediately after its release, topped charts in six countries and regions including Korea, Japan, the U.K., France, Canada and Brazil, and entered the top 10 in a total of 18 countries and regions including the United States, Germany and Australia.
